title: playtime-goal
description: Set daily playtime goals and track your progress with an in-game HUD progress bar.
body:
# Playtime Goals

Set a daily playtime goal and track your progress directly in-game with a clean HUD.

## Features
- **Daily goal** — set how long you want to play today (in minutes)
- **Progress bar HUD** — shows time played vs goal with a color bar
- **Goal reached alert** — pulsing ★ overlay when you hit your goal
- **Saves progress** — tracks playtime across sessions, resets daily
- **Simple menu** — press **G** to open the goals screen

## How it works
The mod tracks how long you've been playing today. When you hit your goal, a celebration overlay appears. Progress saves automatically when you quit.

## Keybinds
| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| G | Open goals menu |

## Installation
1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/)
2. Install [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
3. Drop the jar into your `mods` folder
